introduction.en: An insurance dispute illustrates AI assistance with policy interpretation and correspondence.
introduction.zh: 保险争议案例展示了 AI 对保单理解和申诉沟通的辅助作用。

method.en: Gemini received the complete policy PDF and claim correspondence; the user added trip details and reused the conversation after another refusal.
method.zh: Gemini读取完整保单PDF与理赔往来；用户补充行程细节，并在再次被拒后沿用同一对话。

method.en: It compared the denial with policy wording, proposed an appeal strategy and helped draft a more detailed rebuttal.
method.zh: 它将拒赔理由与保单条款对照，提出申诉思路，并辅助形成更详细的反驳信。

outcome.en: The reported settlement reimbursed the airline change fee after a final internal review; several rounds took roughly five weeks.
outcome.zh: 所述结果为最终内部复核后报销机票改签费，经过多轮往返，约耗时五周。

notes.en: The source describes about three weeks before the first refusal and two more before the second. Document interpretation and tone were the reported benefits, not instant approval.
notes.zh: 源站描述首次拒赔前约三周、第二次拒赔前再过两周；主要帮助是理解文件与改善语气，并非立即获批。
